notes: A wire shopping cart with a bucket and a lower rack. The figures come from a 2025 sheet; the weight and dimensions are shipping figures from that sheet.

gaps: Wire gauge, tube size, steel grade, finish, casters and wheels are not on the sheet, so none are claimed.
The product page's 'fully welded' wording is not used.
The sheet carries a 2025 copyright line and says specifications are subject to change; no production years are given.
method: Unarco M125 spec sheet (PDF, LIT-M125 R1, 2025): read as text and the page rendered to check the table.

comps.spec: Wire cart (the sheet's own label). Total capacity 17,000 cu in (279 L): bucket 9,373 cu in (154 L) plus lower rack 7,627 cu in (125 L). Shipping weight 58 lb; length 43-3/4 in, width 24-1/2 in, height 41-5/16 in.

sources.title: Unarco M125 shopping cart model spec sheet, LIT-M125 R1 (Unarco Industries, copyright 2025)
